fields.name: position_id
fields.notes: Identifies the position

fields.name: currency
fields.notes: Currency of the position's amounts

fields.name: notional
fields.notes: Absolute amount, never negative

datasets.frequency: Per reporting date for the first two fields; the others are the reference values of SRC-02 unless a what-if changes them
datasets.granularity: One record: the Value column of the parameter list, one field per row

fields.name: as_of_date
fields.notes: Name AsOfDate. The reporting date

fields.name: reporting_currency
fields.notes: Name ReportingCcy. Every result is in it; DS-05 lists it with rate 1

fields.name: days_per_year
fields.notes: Name DaysPerYear. Greater than 0. Reference value 365

fields.name: coupon_threshold
fields.notes: Name CouponThreshold. A coupon below it uses the low-coupon time bands

fields.name: scaling_ir
fields.notes: Name ScalingIR. Greater than 0

fields.name: scaling_eq
fields.notes: Name ScalingEQ. Greater than 0

fields.name: scaling_co
fields.notes: Name ScalingCO. Greater than 0

fields.name: scaling_fx
fields.notes: Name ScalingFX. Greater than 0

fields.name: rwa_multiplier
fields.notes: Name RWAMultiplier. Greater than 0

fields.name: vertical_disallowance
fields.notes: Name VerticalDisallowance

fields.name: horizontal_zone_1
fields.notes: Name HorizontalZone1

fields.name: horizontal_zone_2
fields.notes: Name HorizontalZone2

fields.name: horizontal_zone_3
fields.notes: Name HorizontalZone3

fields.name: horizontal_adjacent
fields.notes: Name HorizontalAdjacent. Between zones 1 and 2, and 2 and 3

fields.name: horizontal_zone_1_3
fields.notes: Name HorizontalZone13. Between zones 1 and 3 under the Basel regime

fields.name: eq_specific_rate
fields.notes: Name EQSpecificRate

fields.name: eq_index_rate
fields.notes: Name EQIndexRate. Further charge on an index under the Basel regime

fields.name: eq_general_rate
fields.notes: Name EQGeneralRate

fields.name: fx_charge_rate
fields.notes: Name FXChargeRate

fields.name: gold_code
fields.notes: Name GoldCode. The code gold is entered under in DS-05 and DS-09. Reference value XAU

fields.name: com_directional_rate
fields.notes: Name COMDirectionalRate

fields.name: com_gross_rate
fields.notes: Name COMGrossRate

fields.name: regime
fields.notes: Name Regime. Basel is MAR40, CRR is Article 325(2) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013; read without regard to case. Reference value Basel

fields.name: transitional_multiplier
fields.notes: Name TransitionalMultiplier. Multiplies the requirement under the CRR, on a reporting date up to TransitionalEndDate. Reference value 0.9

fields.name: transitional_end_date
fields.notes: Name TransitionalEndDate. Must be a date under the CRR; a value other than the reference is counted by rule C08. Reference value 2029-12-31

fields.name: total_own_funds
fields.notes: Name TotalOwnFunds. Must be a number greater than 0 under the CRR, where the FX requirement is waived while the overall net open position does not exceed FXDeMinimisRate of it

fields.name: fx_de_minimis_rate
fields.notes: Name FXDeMinimisRate. Reference value 0.02

fields.name: horizontal_zone_1_3_crr
fields.notes: Name HorizontalZone13CRR. Between zones 1 and 3 under the CRR, Article 339(9)(f), in place of HorizontalZone13. Reference value 1.5

fields.name: eq_index_rate_crr
fields.notes: Name EQIndexRateCRR. Charge on the net position per index under the CRR, Article 344, in place of EQIndexRate. Reference value 0

fields.name: eligibility_share_325a
fields.notes: Name EligibilityShare325a. Share of the total assets that the size of the business may not exceed for the simplified standardised approach, Article 325a(1) of the CRR; a rate, 0 to 1. Reference value 0.1

fields.name: eligibility_cap_325a
fields.notes: Name EligibilityCap325a. Amount that the size of the business may not exceed for the simplified standardised approach, Article 325a(1); a number greater than 0. Reference value 500000000

fields.name: eligibility_share_94
fields.notes: Name EligibilityShare94. Share of the total assets that the size of the business may not exceed for the small trading book derogation, Article 94(1); a rate, 0 to 1. Reference value 0.05

fields.name: eligibility_cap_94
fields.notes: Name EligibilityCap94. Amount that the size of the business may not exceed for the small trading book derogation, Article 94(1); a number greater than 0. Reference value 50000000

datasets.frequency: Fixed: the reference values of SRC-02 unless a what-if changes them; the rows of the category CRR are those of SRC-04
datasets.granularity: One row per category, rating grade and range of residual maturity; 31 rows

fields.name: key
fields.notes: Column SR_Key, name SR_Key. Category, rating grade and maturity range joined by a vertical bar, as the workbook builds it for each position

fields.name: category
fields.notes: Column Category. Repeats the first part of the key; not read

fields.name: rating_grade
fields.notes: Column Rating grade. Repeats the second part of the key; not read. Under the category CRR, the risk weight of the credit risk standardised approach

fields.name: residual_maturity
fields.notes: Column Residual maturity. Describes the third part of the key; not read

fields.name: charge
fields.notes: Column Charge, name SR_Charge

fields.name: reference
fields.notes: Column Reference. Not read

datasets.frequency: Fixed: the reference values of SRC-02 unless a what-if changes them
datasets.granularity: One row per time band; 15 rows

fields.name: band
fields.notes: Column Band, name Ladder_Band. The row's position gives the band; the number is not read

fields.name: zone
fields.notes: Column Zone, name Ladder_Zone

fields.name: upper_bound_high_coupon
fields.notes: Name Ladder_UpperHigh. Inclusive. Empty: the band is open-ended, or does not exist for this coupon

fields.name: upper_bound_low_coupon
fields.notes: Name Ladder_UpperLow. Inclusive. Empty: the band is open-ended

fields.name: label_high_coupon
fields.notes: Name Ladder_LabelHigh. Shown on IR_Ladder

fields.name: label_low_coupon
fields.notes: Name Ladder_LabelLow. Shown on IR_Ladder

fields.name: risk_weight
fields.notes: Column Risk weight, name Ladder_RW. 0 or more

fields.name: assumed_yield_change
fields.notes: Column Assumed yield change (pp). For the duration method, which is not supported; not read

datasets.granularity: One row per currency, and one for gold; up to 20 rows

fields.name: currency_id
fields.notes: Name FX_Ccy. The currency code: three letters of ISO 4217, and the gold code for gold. Listed once. The reporting currency is listed

fields.name: description
fields.notes: Not read

fields.name: fx_rate
fields.unit: Units of reporting currency per unit
fields.notes: Name FX_Rate. Greater than 0. The spot rate of the reporting date; 1 for the reporting currency

datasets.granularity: One row per debt position or derivative leg; up to 500 rows

fields.name: position_id
fields.notes: Column PositionID. Unique on the sheet, without regard to case

fields.name: portfolio
fields.notes: Column Portfolio. Not read

fields.name: instrument
fields.notes: Column Instrument, read without regard to case. A row with another value, or none, is rejected

fields.name: currency
fields.notes: Column Currency. A code of DS-05, the gold code excepted

fields.name: direction
fields.notes: Column Direction

fields.name: position_value
fields.notes: Column Position value (ccy). The market value of the principal or of the notional underlying; Direction gives the sign

fields.name: rate_type
fields.notes: Column Rate type

fields.name: coupon
fields.notes: Column Coupon (decimal). Required for a fixed-rate position

fields.name: final_maturity_date
fields.notes: Column Final maturity date. Not before the reporting date

fields.name: next_repricing_date
fields.notes: Column Next repricing date (floating). Required for a floating-rate position: from the reporting date to the final maturity

fields.name: sr_category
fields.notes: Column SR category. NONE: no specific risk. CRR: the category of the CRR regime, the only one of the two (with NONE) that regime accepts; GOV, QUAL and OTHER are those of the Basel regime

fields.name: rating_grade
fields.notes: Column Rating grade. Required unless the category is NONE. With the category, a key of DS-03. Under the category CRR, the risk weight of the credit risk standardised approach that the issuer or the security would receive, as RW 20%; a security that would receive 75% is charged as one at 100%, and a covered bond at 10% as half the category of 20% and 50%

fields.name: issue_id
fields.notes: Column Issue ID (specific-risk netting). Rows with the same value are one issue; empty: an issue of its own

fields.name: book
fields.notes: Column Book. Blank reads as Trading. A Non-trading row is excluded before any other test of the row and counted by C17: the interest rate and equity risk of the non-trading book is outside the scope of the market risk requirement

fields.name: comment
fields.notes: Column Comment. Not read

datasets.granularity: One row per position in a stock or an index; up to 500 rows

fields.name: position_id
fields.notes: Column PositionID. Unique on the sheet, without regard to case

fields.name: portfolio
fields.notes: Column Portfolio. Not read

fields.name: market
fields.notes: Column Market. The national market

fields.name: type
fields.notes: Column Type

fields.name: identifier
fields.notes: Column Stock or index identifier. With the market and the type, it identifies what is netted

fields.name: currency
fields.notes: Column Currency. A code of DS-05, the gold code excepted

fields.name: direction
fields.notes: Column Direction

fields.name: market_value
fields.notes: Column Market value (ccy). Direction gives the sign

fields.name: book
fields.notes: Column Book. Blank reads as Trading. A Non-trading row is excluded before any other test of the row and counted by C17: the interest rate and equity risk of the non-trading book is outside the scope of the market risk requirement

fields.name: comment
fields.notes: Column Comment. Not read

datasets.granularity: One row per position in a commodity; up to 500 rows

fields.name: position_id
fields.notes: Column PositionID. Unique on the sheet, without regard to case

fields.name: portfolio
fields.notes: Column Portfolio. Not read

fields.name: commodity
fields.notes: Column Commodity. Rows with the same name are netted. Never gold: a row whose commodity is the gold code is rejected

fields.name: direction
fields.notes: Column Direction

fields.name: quantity
fields.notes: Column Quantity. Direction gives the sign

fields.name: unit
fields.notes: Column Unit. The standard unit of the quantity; not read

fields.name: spot_price
fields.notes: Column Spot price (ccy per unit). The current spot price of one unit, used as entered

fields.name: currency
fields.notes: Column Currency. A code of DS-05, the gold code excepted

fields.name: maturity_date
fields.notes: Column Maturity date. For the maturity ladder approach, which is not supported; not read

fields.name: book
fields.notes: Column Book. Blank reads as Trading. A Non-trading row is calculated as a trading book row: Article 325(1) of the CRR and MAR12.6 put the foreign exchange and commodity risk of the non-trading book in the scope of the market risk requirement

fields.name: comment
fields.notes: Column Comment. Not read

datasets.granularity: One row per net position in a currency or in gold; up to 500 rows

fields.name: position_id
fields.notes: Column PositionID. Unique on the sheet, without regard to case

fields.name: portfolio
fields.notes: Column Portfolio. Not read

fields.name: currency
fields.notes: Column Currency. A code of DS-05, the gold code included. A row in the reporting currency is excluded

fields.name: direction
fields.notes: Column Direction

fields.name: net_position
fields.notes: Column Amount (ccy). The net open position in the currency; for gold, in the unit its rate is quoted for. Direction gives the sign

fields.name: book
fields.notes: Column Book. Blank reads as Trading. A Non-trading row is calculated as a trading book row: Article 325(1) of the CRR and MAR12.6 put the foreign exchange and commodity risk of the non-trading book in the scope of the market risk requirement

fields.name: comment
fields.notes: Column Comment. Not read

datasets.granularity: One row per risk class; 4 rows

fields.name: risk_class_id
fields.notes: Column Risk class. A label of the template, not typed

fields.name: description
fields.notes: Column Description. A label of the template; not read

fields.name: method
fields.notes: Column Method. The method the charge was calculated by; not read

fields.name: charge
fields.notes: Column Charge (rep ccy), names OptionsIR, OptionsEQ, OptionsCO and OptionsFX. Empty: zero

fields.name: comment
fields.notes: Column Comment. Not read

datasets.granularity: One row per month end; up to 24 rows

fields.name: month_end
fields.notes: Column Month end. The last day of a calendar month, one month after the row entered before it. A row without it is skipped. Read under the CRR regime only

fields.name: total_assets
fields.notes: Column Total assets (EUR). Of the institution at the month end. Must be a number greater than 0

fields.name: long_325a
fields.notes: Column Long 325a (EUR). The aggregated long positions of Article 325a(2); any sign, the absolute value is taken. Must be a number: 0 where there is none

fields.name: short_325a
fields.notes: Column Short 325a (EUR). The aggregated short positions of Article 325a(2); any sign, the absolute value is taken. Must be a number: 0 where there is none

fields.name: long_94
fields.notes: Column Long 94 (EUR). The aggregated long positions of Article 94(3); any sign, the absolute value is taken. Must be a number: 0 where there is none

fields.name: short_94
fields.notes: Column Short 94 (EUR). The aggregated short positions of Article 94(3); any sign, the absolute value is taken. Must be a number: 0 where there is none
